## S012 — Why is it called "Vietnam"? The 1804 name deal with the Qing #shorts

**Description**

```
In 1802 the new Nguyễn ruler Gia Long asked the Qing court to recognize his state as Nam Việt. Beijing objected and preferred An Nam. The compromise: the same two words, reversed — Việt Nam, announced in 1804. Each court explained the name its own way.
Sources: Trần Thị Xuân, 'From Regional Identity to National Designation: Gia Long and the Naming of Việt Nam', Thang Long Journal of Science (2024), using Qing archives and Đại Nam thực lục; A. Woodside, Vietnam and the Chinese Model (1971); Library of Congress Country Study: Vietnam; Encyclopædia Universalis.
Illustrations and narration are AI-assisted. Corrections welcome in the comments. #Vietnam #China #History #Shorts
```
